architecture_summary.overview: Fallback demo data keeps the product walkthrough visible when live repository analysis is unavailable.
architecture_summary.data_flow: Submit repository -> analyze -> synthesize -> display tour

tour_steps.title: Submit screen
tour_steps.narration: The submit screen captures the repository URL and role. It starts the onboarding job only after the GitHub URL passes validation.

tour_steps.title: FastAPI routes
tour_steps.narration: The API creates a job and sends the request into the asynchronous analysis pipeline. This is the boundary between the browser and backend orchestration.

tour_steps.title: Repository ingestion
tour_steps.narration: The ingestion service performs a shallow Git clone and collects basic repository metadata. This gives downstream agents a concrete local repository to inspect.

tour_steps.title: Tree-sitter parser
tour_steps.narration: The parser walks code files and extracts structural symbols. AST-aware evidence is what makes the later code tour grounded in actual source locations.

tour_steps.title: Chunking
tour_steps.narration: The chunker converts parsed symbols into bounded evidence units. Those chunks become the retrieval surface for repository questions.

tour_steps.title: Bob client
tour_steps.narration: The Bob client isolates the external analysis engine behind a stable interface. The same interface supports the Architecture and Business Logic agents.

tour_steps.title: Synthesis
tour_steps.narration: Synthesis ranks evidence and creates exactly eight tour steps. Every step points back to a file and line range that a developer can inspect.

tour_steps.title: Grounded Q&A
tour_steps.narration: Q&A retrieves repository chunks before asking the model to answer. Citation validation prevents answers from displaying unsupported source ranges.
